iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 67. STABLE: Islamabad talks collapsed - US demands 20-year enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 years. UN nuclear chief Grossi urges IAEA checks in any deal. Trump claims Iran 'agreed to everything' - Iran calls claims 'alternative facts'. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. 2nd round talks expected this weekend. Hormuz reimposition may affect nuclear deal dynamics. Probability 33%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 67. RISING: BREAKING - Iran RE-IMPOSES Strait of Hormuz restrictions, accusing US of violating deal. Iranian gunboats fired on tanker. Military says Hormuz 'only open during ceasefire'. Ceasefire expires Apr 22 in 4 days. Pakistani FM says US-Iran deal 'very close'. US naval blockade continues. Oil volatile. $760M suspicious oil bet still under scrutiny. CT-ISW warns Iran exploiting ceasefire to regenerate missile force. Probability 42%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 67. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire (started Apr 16) mostly holding, expires Apr 26. First Israel-Lebanon direct talks in decades. Israel holds 10km buffer zone. Hezbollah NOT part of deal - remains armed, vows to fight. Israeli drone killed 1 in south Lebanon. Lebanese leaders discuss future talks. Hormuz reimposition complicates regional dynamics. Probability 16%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opened Europe's largest warhead plant (Lalahan), fuel plant, missile integration facilities Apr 7. 'Largest defense investment in Republic history.' TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic (Mach-5, 1500km range) entering mass production. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. Defense spending $27.34B. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: US Think Tank (CFR) warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 - Tier II risk. Follows brief 3-day military conflict (Operation Sindoor - precision strikes on 9 terror camps). First India-Pakistan drone war in May 2025. India rejected claims of US mediation in ceasefire. PM Sharif in Qatar mediating regional affairs. Probability 7%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 69. RISING: Finland lifting decades-old ban on hosting nuclear weapons. First of 64 Finnish F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment 'poses threat to Russia, will force countermeasures.' Russia reinforcing nuclear/Arctic assets near Finnish border. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 24%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: RISING: Reuters confirms China changing tactics on Taiwan/Japan amid Middle East chaos. China says military activities around Taiwan 'reasonable and justified' - defiant posture. Blocking Philippines from disputed shoal. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun for 2028 elections outreach. CBS: China weighing supplying Iran advanced radar. ISW/AEI update Apr 17: escalating on multiple fronts. Taiwan extended conscription, $14B US arms. Probability 36%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 65. STABLE: Kim oversaw 3-day weapons test series including cluster-bomb warheads on ballistic missiles. 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer. ICBM engine test for US-mainland-capable missile. 6th missile test of 2026. Cruise missile tests from new warship. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. No new nuclear test. Probability 10%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1170+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles, 16+ killed, 118+ wounded across Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa, Dnipro. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - Baltic ports Primorsk (40% storage lost), Ust-Luga (30%), Crimea Feodosia destroyed. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. Russia warns Europe. ISW: Russia maintains expansive territorial goals. Polymarket: 0.4% ceasefire by Apr 30. Probability 88%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi - 2nd round concluded, agreed not to escalate but fighting continues. Pakistan declared 'open war' on Taliban regime - bombed Kabul and other cities. China Foreign Ministry 'actively mediating.' Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed. CSIS: crisis drifting from resolution. Border clashes ongoing. PM Sharif in Qatar for regional diplomacy. Probability 8%. Stable.
